records.title: CNT: Safety-oriented Function Reuse across LLMs via Cross-Model Neuron Transfer
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨を確認。The widespread deployment of large language models (LLMs) calls for post-hoc methods that can flexibly adapt models to evolving safety requirements. Meanwhile, the rapidly expanding open-source LLM ecosystem has produced a diverse collection of models that already exhibit various safety-related functionalities.
